name: Toyota Motor Manufacturing Texas - San Antonio TX

fieldNotes.site: TMMTX — the $1.2B San Antonio assembly plant that Chris Nielsen designed and built (2003-2006); produces Tundra and Tacoma trucks. Notable for an integrated on-site supplier park: ~20 co-located Tier-1 supplier buildings inside the campus feeding the assembly line directly.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Fully fenced, security-controlled campus. Web sources confirm the main gate is reached where Lone Star Pass / Watson Rd dead-ends into the campus at Applewhite Rd, with visitors continuing through the intersection to the Main Gate. Truck entrances are controlled checkpoints. truckGate true, high confidence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Manned guard houses are standard at Toyota assembly-plant primary gates and the 'Main Gate' is a staffed checkpoint; small guard structures visible near the plant entrance. guardShack true; remoteGs false.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Substantial trailer drop yards visible center-campus (rows of trailers near the assembly plant and logistics buildings) — placed in the 25-50 band, flagged uncertain; the on-site supplier-park model reduces external trailer staging vs. a comparable Toyota plant. dropYard true.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Extensive dock banks on the assembly plant, logistics buildings and the ~20 supplier buildings; 130 conservative estimate, 50+ band certain.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus is effectively a manufacturing park: central assembly plant plus ~20 on-site supplier buildings plus logistics/utility structures and an on-site test track. multipleFacilities true.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Located at the rural southern edge of San Antonio surrounded by open scrubland and farmland — judged Rural per rubric (edge-of-metro, open country setting).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Inbound supplier/parts flow (supplier park + cross-dock) is physically separate from finished-vehicle (Tundra/Tacoma) outbound staging.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane internal roads and large gate aprons leave room for express/bypass lanes.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail-served (standard for an assembly plant of this scale; the plant was master-planned with rail access).
fieldNotes.perimeter: Box covers the core developed campus including the supplier park; TMMTX owns substantial additional buffer/test-track land beyond it.
